name: Shop floor
summary: Puts the open builds and the low components on the shop-floor board, and queues the completion of each build the floor marks ready. Crons read and draft; a person approves every completion.

all.evidence: 2 discovery calls describe how work moves through their shop floor

covered_by.production-run: approval (completion queued once the floor marks the build ready)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (board and stock list in the store)

crons.name: schedule
crons.summary: Open builds from the platform onto the shop-floor board.

crons.name: stock
crons.summary: Components below their minimum level, from stock on hand.

crons.name: complete-builds
crons.summary: Queue completion of each build the floor has marked ready, for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations here are reads only: the board and the stock list are kept in the workflow store and reach nobody outside the business. Completing a build changes stock and the build record, so it is a live operation and waits for a person.

unleashed.covers: open builds, stock on hand, build completion (approval only)

gaps: Unleashed is signed in core/sdk (HMAC-SHA256 on each request), so the crons and approvals call it through the gate. It needs UNLEASHED_API_ID, UNLEASHED_API_KEY and UNLEASHED_CLIENT_TYPE in the deploy's secret store. Nothing has run against a live Unleashed account yet.

Acumatica, Fishbowl and Odoo: docs read, but the kit maps no operations for this job (Odoo's ops file holds one docs page). Setup, in-process checks, final inspection, rework or scrap, time logging and dispatch are not covered by any mapped platform.
Unleashed list calls send no filters, so each cron reads the first page only (200 records by default). Paging is not built.
POST /Assemblies/{assemblyGuid}/Complete: the kit maps this operation with no body, so none is sent. Confirm on a sandbox account before approving a live completion.
The ERP named on the calls is not identified, so it is not mapped.
Order release from a sales order, job costing and invoicing, and sales shipments (dispatch) are not built as crons.
Judgment steps stay with the floor: setting up a machine, checking a part against a drawing, and deciding on rework or scrap. The agent may summarise the board but does not decide these.
Minimum stock levels are not in the stock endpoint, so they come from settings.reorder_levels, typed in by the business.
Docs-only until a sandbox Unleashed account proves the reads and the completion.

evidence.calls: 2 of 3 shop-floor discovery calls describe how work moves through the floor
evidence.platforms: Acumatica, Fishbowl and Odoo docs read: no mapped operations for this job. Unleashed is mapped in the kit (146 operations) and its requests are signed in core/sdk; no live run yet.
